body.heading: Where in the world is Liechtenstein?
paragraphs: Liechtenstein is a country in Western Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Liechtenstein is Vaduz.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Liechtenstein is German.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Liechtenstein is the Swiss franc.

body.heading: How big is Liechtenstein?
paragraphs: Liechtenstein covers about 160 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Malta.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Vaduz Castle, home of the Prince's family, watches over one of Europe's smallest capitals — with a car-free main street of museums and cafés below.
Malbun is Liechtenstein's family ski village in a high Alpine bowl — gentle slopes, summer hiking and falconry shows with birds of prey.
